### Ballot accepted before submission **Medium Severity** For `E-OMSB2A-DEV`, subagent-1’s ballot is recorded as submitted at `2026-08-01T13:05:00Z` while `receivedAt` is `2026-08-01T07:32:20Z`, and the tally closes at `07:32:58Z`. Acceptance cannot precede submission, so the synced election ledger contradicts its own timeline.
Additional Locations (2) - [`amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omsb2a-dev/ballots/subagent-1.json#L9-L10`](https://github.com/amadeus-dlc/amadeus/blob/a4d06e521d615141839e42dbd181f86489007628/amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omsb2a-dev/ballots/subagent-1.json#L9-L10) - [`amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omsb2a-dev/record.md#L8-L9`](https://github.com/amadeus-dlc/amadeus/blob/a4d06e521d615141839e42dbd181f86489007628/amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omsb2a-dev/record.md#L8-L9)
Fix in Cursor Fix in Web

実測確認しました。submittedAt は投票者(subagent)の自己申告値で CLI 検証がなく、受理刻印 receivedAt(こちらが authoritative)と矛盾しうる構造欠陥です。台帳は append-only 証跡のため書き換えず、ツール側の恒久対策(受理側刻印 or fail-closed 検証)を #1946 として起票しました。record.md は両値を併記しており receivedAt を正としてお読みください。

### Placeholder ballot after acceptance **Low Severity** For `E-OMSCG-S13`, subagent-1’s ballot uses `submittedAt` `2026-08-02T00:00:00Z` while `receivedAt` is `2026-08-01T19:50:49Z` and the election tallies at `19:51:24Z` the same day. The midnight placeholder postdates acceptance and the established result.
Additional Locations (1) - [`amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omscg-s13/ballots/subagent-1.json#L9-L10`](https://github.com/amadeus-dlc/amadeus/blob/a4d06e521d615141839e42dbd181f86489007628/amadeus/spaces/default/elections/260801-e-omscg-s13/ballots/subagent-1.json#L9-L10)
Fix in Cursor Fix in Web
同根です(submittedAt = LLM 投票者の自己申告・無検証。00:00:00Z は placeholder)。receivedAt 19:50:49Z が authoritative で、開票 19:51:24Z との順序は正常です。ツール側の恒久対策は #1946 で追跡します。
